metaDescription: Try Simple Bank's core banking flow yourself — create an account, deposit funds, and transfer money — no sign-up, no backend, fully simulated.

start.title: Walk through the entire Simple Bank flow yourself
start.description: This is a fully working simulation of the real app — the same forms, validation, and ledger behavior — running entirely in your browser. Nothing you do here touches the real backend or requires an account.
start.step1Description: Give it a name and a description, just like the real dashboard.
start.step2Description: Fund the account and watch the balance update instantly.
start.step3Description: Pick a recipient and move money between accounts.
start.step4Description: See every entry recorded exactly like the real account page.

createAccount.title: Create your first account
createAccount.description: Every Simple Bank journey starts here. Fill in a name and description — the same two fields the real "Create account" dialog asks for — then review and confirm.
createAccount.emptyDescription: Create an account to see it appear here, just like on the real dashboard.

deposit.title: Deposit into your account
deposit.description: Pick the account, enter an amount, and confirm — the balance updates the moment the deposit lands.
deposit.guardDescription: You'll need an account before you can deposit into one.

transfer.title: Transfer to another account
transfer.description: Choose a recipient — a recent contact or search by account number — then send funds from your balance.
transfer.guardDescription: You'll need an account with a balance before you can transfer money.

complete.title: That's the whole loop
complete.description: Account, deposit, transfer, ledger — the exact same flow real Simple Bank customers use. Everything above ran locally in your browser; nothing was sent anywhere.
complete.guardDescription: Complete the earlier steps to build up a ledger you can review.
